in_marathi.name: Bishwajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bishwajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bishwajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bishwa' meaning universe and 'Jit' meaning conqueror. The name signifies the one who conquers the universe.

in_bengali.name: Bishwajit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
